Effect: capital victory point value raised, +1 civilian factory, +1 building slot. If the capital's victory point province is not already urban, it becomes a city province: HoI4 cannot change terrain during the game, so it gets a permanent province modifier that fights like urban terrain (-30% attack against it, slower movement, better defence), and the state is upgraded one category. Already urban in the base map: Gorky (GRK), Perm (ARB), Samara (RFS). Converted: Kirov (RUE), Vologda (VGD), Gayny (OSG), Syktyvkar (KMR), Solikamsk (RNS). Orenburg (SPT) has no victory point at all, so it first gets one on the town's province. Works for any capital, including one a warlord has moved.
